Public Policy is a cornerstone of that commitment—helping us navigate complex regulatory landscapes, engage transparently with stakeholders, and contribute to solutions on shared challenges like sustainability, health, and economic development. As Director, Public Policy , you will lead the development and implementation of policy engagement strategies that support business objectives and uphold compliance standards across Egypt market. This role builds constructive relationships with government, trade associations, NGOs, and key influencers, enabling The Coca‑Cola Company to anticipate policy changes, shape frameworks responsibly, and strengthen trust with communities and stakeholders. If you thrive at the intersection of business strategy, governance, and multi-stakeholder engagement, this position offers an opportunity to create meaningful impact across the system and society. What You’ll Do For Us Develop public policy strategy for assigned geography, addressing key areas such as sustainability, packaging, health & wellness, taxation, trade, and digital governance. Monitor legislative and regulatory developments; assess risks and opportunities to ensure proactive business alignment. Build relationships with policymakers, regulators, trade associations, NGOs, and other external stakeholders to foster dialogue and shared value initiatives. Coordinate cross-functional partnerships with Legal, PACS, Sustainability, Marketing, and Commercial teams to integrate policy priorities into business programs without prescriptive authority. Prepare advocacy material, stakeholder briefings, and evidence-based position papers ensuring compliance with governance and ethical standards. Support risk management processes by escalating potential policy impacts and enabling scenario planning within business teams. Represent the company at industry forums and regulatory consultations to promote responsible practices and collaborative solutions. Drive adherence to marketing compliance policies, including marketing-to-children guidelines, health claims integrity, and data privacy principles. Enable capability building across OU and system teams to raise policy awareness and governance rigor. Champion inclusion, sustainability, and responsible engagement in all policy-related initiatives. Requirements & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Law, Economics, or related field; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in government affairs, public policy, regulatory advocacy, or corporate affairs within FMCG or similar sectors. Deep understanding of legislative and regulatory processes and stakeholder ecosystems relevant to social, economic, and environmental policy. Proven ability to manage complex policy portfolios and navigate ambiguity across diverse markets and cultures. Familiarity with global sustainability frameworks and health regulations highly desirable. Exceptional collaboration and influencing skills within matrix organizations. Strong skills in communication, negotiation, and preparing clear, persuasive advocacy content. Ability to uphold compliance and ethics standards rigorously while advancing constructive engagement. Agile, forward-thinking approach—anticipating policy trends and integrating insights into long-term planning. What We’ll Do For You Provide a platform to shape policy solutions that enable responsible business growth and positive societal impact. Offer opportunities to collaborate across global networks, industry forums, and cross-functional teams on high-visibility priorities. Support your growth through specialized learning and broad engagement with regulatory, sustainability, and corporate governance disciplines. Empower you to make a difference by influencing policies that align business innovation with community well-being.

review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer（远程办公）
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 About Remote People At Remote People, we're building the infrastructure to power borderless teams. By handling global payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance, our technology enables businesses to hire anyone anywhere compliantly at the push of a button. If you're interested in adding to our vision of enabling people to work in dream jobs, for every company, and from anywhere in the world, apply now! We're committed to building a global, diverse team representing different and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability. Being part of Remote People means being part of a growing, international family. Overview We're seeking an Intermediate DevOps Engineer with solid infrastructure fundamentals, a platform-first mindset, and a drive to grow fast in a high-ownership environment. What you'll be doing You'll be part of our DevOps team, working closely with engineering squads across a remote-first organisation spread across Asia and Europe. Your primary focus will be on three things: keeping our platform reliable and scalable, making our observability stack actionable, and reducing friction in build and release processes so engineers can ship with confidence. You'll collaborate asynchronously and across time zones as a matter of course. AI tooling is a first-class part of how we work: you'll use it to accelerate automation and infrastructure work, while developing sharp judgment about validating its output. Responsibilities Ensure availability, reliability and security of our SaaS platform across environments Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that make build, test and release processes fast, safe and self-service for engineering squads Leverage Infrastructure as Code to automate infrastructure provisioning and management Implement and improve observability tooling — metrics, logs and traces — so squads can understand system behaviour and act on it Monitor platform capacity and performance, forecasting resource needs proactively Investigate and resolve production incidents, contributing to root cause analysis and preventive follow-up Support engineering squads in integrating their services smoothly within the platform infrastructure Use AI tools to accelerate automation scripting and infrastructure work, with judgment to review and validate generated output Requirements Minimum of 3 years as a DevOps or SRE Engineer Strong understanding of DevOps principles: CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Configuration Management Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS Experience with containerisation technologies — Docker and Kubernetes Experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI) Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK) Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash or Go Ability to communicate effectively in a remote environment — clear written communication, reliable async collaboration Preferred Skills Familiarity with AI tools applied to infrastructure automation, and a willingness to build a disciplined workflow around them Experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure automation tooling Experience working on a SaaS platform or public software product Understanding of security best practices in a DevOps environment Self-directed and curious: you take ownership of your tasks, seek feedback proactively, and drive your own growth without waiting to be pushed What it's like working at Remote People Our service & product. We're a technology company, not an accountancy, payroll provider, recruitment firm or similar. We build a workforce management platform that allows our customers to hire the best talent in minutes, without worrying about compliance, payroll, or HR admin. Our amazing team and environment. Working at Remote People means you're working on something very exciting: Allowing every person on the planet to have access to equal opportunities in living a fulfilled work and personal life. We believe in hiring from within and going the extra mile to retain top talent. As the company continues to grow extremely fast, you will be given the opportunity to develop and grow alongside. Our benefits and perks. Being part of Remote People means that you get the benefit of: A competitive salary An asynchronous working environment A "Remote-First" company environment (or Hybrid) - based on the nature of the job The ability to work from abroad for a short period of time Growth opportunities within the company We provide all new joiners with the necessary hardware to ensure you have the tools you need to succeed from day one

Always collaborate with other staff and Customers. Assist the Team Lead and Service Delivery Manager as required

review_candidates.description: Are you an experienced BMS Engineer looking for your next challenge? We're looking for a talented BMS Support Engineer to join our Southern Support team, reporting to the Regional Operations Manager. Working primarily on Trend Controls and IQ Vision systems , you'll support a varied portfolio of customer sites, carrying out planned maintenance, fault finding, repairs and technical support activities. This is an excellent opportunity to join one of the UK's leading Building Management Systems specialists and become part of a business that values technical excellence, collaboration and personal development. What You'll Do Carry out planned preventative maintenance on Trend BMS systems. Diagnose and resolve faults to ensure systems continue to operate effectively and efficiently. Complete small repairs, remedial works and system modifications. Respond to service calls and support customers during system failures and outages. Carry out routine inspections and health checks of BMS equipment. Produce clear and accurate service reports following site visits. Build strong relationships with customers by providing professional and responsive technical support. Participate in the out-of-hours call-out rota. What We're Looking For Proven experience working within the Building Management Systems (BMS) industry. Strong knowledge of Trend Controls and IQ Vision is essential. Experience of Siemens, Tridium Niagara, Schneider EcoStruxure or other BMS platforms would be advantageous. Excellent fault-finding, diagnostic and problem-solving skills. Good understanding of HVAC plant and mechanical building services. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to customers. Able to work independently while contributing to a wider support team. Good IT and report-writing skills. Willingness to participate in an on-call rota. Full UK driving licence. Located within a reasonable travelling distance of Farnborough. What We Offer Competitive salary. Generous bonus scheme. Standby allowance and call-out payments. Company car scheme, including electric vehicle options, or monthly car allowance. Company pension scheme with a 6% employer contribution. Private medical insurance with BUPA. Life assurance of four times annual salary. 25 days holiday plus bank holidays. Option to purchase up to five additional days' holiday each year. Cycle to Work scheme. Ongoing training and development opportunities. A supportive and collaborative working environment. Why Join BMSI? At BMSI, we help our customers create smarter, safer and more sustainable buildings. In return, we invest in our people, providing opportunities to develop their careers, work with market-leading technology and make a genuine impact. Ready to take the next step in your BMS career? We'd love to hear from you. BMSI is an equal opportunities employer.

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analista de Sustentação de Sistemas | Observabilidade (Noturno) based in Brazil. This is a key opportunity for a systems support professional focused on observability, incident management, and production stability. You will monitor the health and performance of Web and Mobile applications in a remote, technology-driven environment. The role combines incident response, advanced troubleshooting, log analysis, and proactive monitoring of critical systems. You will use leading observability and APM tools to identify anomalies, mitigate incidents, and investigate root causes. The position also involves validating canary deployments and ensuring that new releases remain stable after rollout. Your work will directly contribute to system reliability, service continuity, and a high-quality digital experience. The role operates during the night shift and is well suited to professionals who thrive in technically challenging production environments. Accountabilities Manage and monitor support tickets and incidents through ServiceNow, diagnosing issues and mitigating incidents within established SLAs. Monitor application health, performance metrics, and distributed traces for Web and Mobile environments using Datadog and/or Dynatrace. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root-cause investigations using centralized logs through Elasticsearch and Kibana. Analyze application behavior, identify anomalies, and support the resolution of production incidents. Monitor and validate canary deployments, analyzing error rates, performance metrics, and abnormal behavior following releases. Support production stability by proactively identifying potential issues and escalating critical incidents appropriately. Prepare technical documentation and detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports in ServiceNow. Maintain clear records of incidents, investigations, mitigations, and resolutions to support continuous improvement. Collaborate with technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to more resilient and observable systems. Requirements Previous experience managing support tickets and incidents using ServiceNow. Strong practical knowledge of observability and Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools such as Datadog and/or Dynatrace. Hands-on experience analyzing logs and troubleshooting production issues with Elasticsearch and Kibana. Experience monitoring canary deployments and validating errors and system behavior in production Web and Mobile environments. Ability to investigate technical incidents systematically and identify potential root causes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a proactive approach to incident resolution. Good communication skills and the ability to document technical findings clearly. Ability to work effectively in production support environments governed by SLAs and operational procedures. Availability to work the 22:00–07:00 night shift. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with engineering, support, and technical teams. Benefits Remote work model with flexibility in working hours. Medical and dental insurance. Life insurance. Transportation allowance. Meal and food allowance. Wellhub fitness and wellness benefit. Childcare assistance. Assistance for employees with children with disabilities. Performance-based bonus. Birthday day off. Alelo Multibenefícios. Allya partnerships and discounts. Pet health insurance. Extended parental leave through the Empresa Cidadã program. Flexible dress code. Bike and scooter parking when working from the office. Opportunities for cross-functional and cross-brand career development. Collaborative, inclusive, and horizontal organizational environment. Programs focused on employee experience, culture, development, and continuous learning. Opportunities to work with modern technology, data, AI, and large-scale digital products. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
